diffs.diff: magnetic field X/Y/Z (mgauss): datasheet reading gives 1.5 per count, the part's model has 0.0015, 0.0015, 0.0015
diffs.evidence: ST LIS2MDL datasheet Table 3 'Sensor characteristics': 'So Sensitivity ... Typ. 1.5 mgauss/LSB' (FS = ±49.152 gauss). The model's sim measures use unit 'gauss' (sim.unit and controls unit = gauss) and the driver converts with _SENS_GAUSS = 0.0015; 1.5 mgauss/LSB = 0.0015 gauss/LSB, so the two readings are the same sensitivity in different units (mgauss vs gauss). No change needed.
